question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: Four keyless requests at the endpoint the vendor's MCP page publishes: a JSON-RPC initialize, a sessionless tools/list, a plain GET of the same path, and an initialize at /sse. Then one keyless GET of the REST API. No tool was called.

headers.www-authenticate: Bearer realm="OAuth", resource_metadata="https://mcp.squareup.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp", error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing or invalid access token"

decoded.one-body-for-four-shapes: initialize at 12:31:00.505Z, sessionless tools/list at 12:31:01.148Z, plain GET at 12:31:01.774Z and initialize at /sse at 12:31:02.249Z all answered 401 with 79 bytes and ONE sha256, fde5a2f4681d6c07ac053684ff82e9c3a1b6d6141388f8551d551f27e3d3ad45: {"error":"invalid_token","error_description":"Missing or invalid access token"}. The refusal does not vary by method here, where mcp.figma.com answers 405 to a GET of its MCP path, and /sse is not a separate server on this host.
decoded.rest: GET connect.squareup.com/v2/locations at 12:31:05.776Z: 401, 161 bytes, sha256 e69042062232d5308e43bbcabbefec41605bd50d5502266593a445e4d61497f7, carrying "category": "AUTHENTICATION_ERROR", "code": "UNAUTHORIZED", "detail": "This request could not be authorized." and NO www-authenticate header at all.
decoded.cross-vendor-identity: The 79-byte body and its digest are byte-identical to what mcp.wix.com/mcp and mcp.asana.com/sse served to this researcher within the same hour, all three behind Server: cloudflare. Three unrelated vendors, one refusal body: a survey that fingerprints an endpoint by its 401 body would merge them. What produces the shared body is not measured and no inference about a shared vendor or gateway is made here.
decoded.ownership: /.well-known/public-agents.json answers 404 on mcp.squareup.com (13 bytes) and on developer.squareup.com and squareup.com (28 bytes each), so this listing is unclaimed and says so.
decoded.not-measured: the tool list, any tool name, whether any tool writes, and everything behind a credential. One container is one sample.

finding: The endpoint Square's own MCP page publishes, https://mcp.squareup.com/mcp, refuses an anonymous caller identically in four shapes: a JSON-RPC initialize, a sessionless tools/list, a plain GET and an initialize at /sse, sent 2026-10-22T12:31:00.505Z to 12:31:02.249Z with no credential, each 401 with the same 79-byte body (invalid_token, "Missing or invalid access token", sha256 fde5a2f4...) and an RFC 9728 challenge pointing at the host's own protected-resource document. No tool name is readable without an account, so noAccountNeeded is false and auth is oauth. The REST API refuses the same way with a different body and no challenge. That 79-byte body is byte-identical to the one mcp.wix.com and mcp.asana.com/sse serve, which is worth knowing before anyone identifies an MCP endpoint by its refusal.
